messages:
maria-finance: Heads-up — new price sheet v3 just landed in the shared drive. We discovered 9 legacy reserved accounts that might fall into a grandfathering gap when we flip the A/B PAYG rates tomorrow morning. :eyes:
ash-product: Can you clarify what the gap is? I thought grandfathering covered all reserved SKUs for existing customers.
liam-billing: Quick summary: grandfathering rule is based on `contract_signed_date` + SKU mapping. The experiment changes PAYG base for new customers, but our SKU mapping table has 3 old SKU aliases that don't match, so a few reserved customers are treated as non-grandfathered and would get billed at experiment rates.
sofia-legal: If those are billed incorrectly we need a remediation plan and a customer notification template. We also need sign-off before we auto-credit.
maria-finance: Agreed. I pulled a list: 9 accounts (enterprise tier) — total monthly delta if misbilled would be ~ $14k. We can either patch the SKU alias mapping before rollout or apply manual credits after invoices. Patch preferred.
olivia-eng: I can push a mapping fix, but it needs a deploy window. The change is small (one-row canonicalization table) and low risk. Can we do a quick canary? deploy-bot: deploy queued: release/sku-alias-fix -> staging (build 4821). Estimated deploy time 00:03:00.
nash-product: If staging looks good, promote to prod. Need the finance ACK to hold off rollout until prod is green.
liam-billing: Also FYI — vendor pass-through fee from our GPU partner increased for multi-tenant bursts; if the experiment causes bursts we might need to update the vendor surcharge logic. That affects margin on PAYG.
maria-finance: Good call. Can you quantify the incremental vendor fee exposure if the A cohort sees +20% token usage?
liam-billing: Rough calc: additional vendor fees ~ $1.8k/month across affected accounts at +20% usage. I'll add that to the risk doc.
sofia-legal: We should not message customers about pricing changes until we confirm grandfathering status for those 9. Drafting a notification now in case we need to send credits and a note.
maria-finance: Plan: 1) Olivia pushes mapping fix to prod and smoke-test, 2) Billing runs reconciliation script against invoices yesterday->today to ensure no mischarges, 3) If anything slipped through, we issue manual credits and send notification. Approvals: CFO or head of finance to authorize credits up to $20k.
nash-product: I can hold the A/B split rollout flag for 1 more cycle. Ping me when prod is green.
olivia-eng: Staging deploy passed. Running smoke invoice generation (local). Snippet of smoke check:
```
# billing smoke calc
for acct in candidates:
  expected = legacy_price if acct.grandfathered else experiment_price
  if invoice_line != expected:
    flag_for_credit(acct)
```
liam-billing: Ran the smoke script against yesterday's export — found 2 accounts that would have been misclassified. Flagging them now.
maria-finance: Running numbers. If we credit both fully it's ~$2,350. Sofia — legal ok with notification wording that includes a credit offer?
sofia-legal: Yes, keep it short and customer-friendly. No admission of fault; state "we applied the legacy rate for your historical usage and issued a credit" and include a link to billing portal. I'll attach the template.

maria-finance: OK — can CFO approve up to $20k in manual credits? @ash-product, can you loop in finance head?
ash-product: Looping in @cj-cfo (DMed). cj-cfo: I saw the note — approve up to $25k for remediation. Proceed but document the root cause and add a postmortem to the rollout ticket.
liam-billing: Credits queued. Command used for credits (internal):
```
billing credits create --account $ACCT_ID --amount 2350 --reason "grandfathering adjustment"
```
maria-finance: Credits applied to the 2 accounts. Olivia — when you promote the SKU alias fix to prod, please add a one-line migration note to the release so the reconciliation team can trace it.
olivia-eng: Will do. Promoting to prod now. Deploy-bot: promoted release/sku-alias-fix -> prod (build 4821). No rollback signals in the first 10m. :shipit:
maria-finance: Great. Nash — you can flip the A/B flag once you confirm the reconciliation job completes and shows zero remaining misclassifications.
nash-product: I'll wait for the reconciliation job result and then flip. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
